title: Technology Partners

fields.label: Section heading
fields.name: technology_partners_heading
fields.instructions: Centered heading above the partner logo grid, sitewide (footer.php, directly above the footer).

fields.label: Partners
fields.name: technology_partners
fields.instructions: One card per partner. Add/reorder freely — the grid wraps to as many rows as needed, no template change required to add a 6th, 7th, etc.

sub_fields.label: Logo
sub_fields.name: partner_logo
sub_fields.instructions: Shown centered, object-fit: contain, max-height 120px — any native aspect ratio is fine. Leave empty to show an honest gray placeholder box (partner name as its label) instead of a stand-in stock logo.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: partner_description
sub_fields.instructions: Short, one line. Leave empty for now — the card simply omits this paragraph until it's filled in.

sub_fields.label: Link (optional)
sub_fields.name: partner_link
sub_fields.instructions: “Find out more” destination — an internal page (e.g. a product page) or the partner's own site. Leave empty to render the card with no CTA button (icon still shows) if this partner doesn't need one.

description: Sitewide ‘Our Partners’ technology-partner logo grid (footer.php, directly above the <footer>) — distinct from ‘Partners, Not Vendors’ (group_7f2a4c9e01d3, the About page's 4-card trust-philosophy section; unrelated content, kept as a separate options page to avoid confusion between the two). Added 2026-08-24. Reuses the same card visual language as the Real Use Cases carousel's flip-card back face (F4F3F6 panel, bold 24px name, gray 14px description, dark circle double-arrow icon bottom-right) but as static, non-flipping cards — see template-parts/partners.php.
